name: letta
label: Letta
description: Letta is the platform for building stateful agents: open AI with advanced memory that can learn and self-improve over time.

apiKey.label: API Key
apiKey.description: Your Letta API key (required for Letta Cloud, leave empty for self-hosted)

baseUrl.label: Base URL
baseUrl.description: Server URL for self-hosted instances (e.g., http://localhost:8283). Leave empty to use Letta Cloud. The host only, without https://, such as name.example.com.

letta_list_models.label: List Models
letta_list_models.description: Lists available LLM or embedding models.

embedding.label: Embedding Models
embedding.description: yes = list embedding models; no (default) = list LLMs.

provider_name.label: Provider Name
provider_name.description: Only LLMs from this provider, such as openai. Ignored for embedding models.
